episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: After a chance encounter with Grand Prince I-an, chaebol heiress Seong Huiju schemes to rise higher.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Huiju is pushed to meet with potential suitors. Grand Prince I-an considers accepting her proposal.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: A secret rendezvous scandal rocks the royal family, and Grand Prince I-an makes a public statement.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: When Huiju moves into Grand Prince I-an's residence and proves to be a handful, a conspiracy awaits…

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: As Huiju digs for the truth, Grand Prince I-an distances himself thinking it is safer to stay away.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: The celebrated pair makes a dazzling return at the banquet, waltzing and professing their fake love.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: With the wedding looming, everyone begins to realize a strange turn in the couple's relationship.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: The 21st-century Grand Prince's wife arrives. Amid cheers and wary eyes, two men make a bold choice.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Facing a political crisis, the couple choose to fight to protect one another, each in their own way.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Others step in for the couple who struggle to be honest, and a new era begins to stir at the court.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Like that day, fire engulfs Council Hall. Huiju protects Grand Prince I-an while fighting an enemy.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: No barrier is unbreakable, only those who wish it so. Can they leap beyond and shape their destiny?
